oauth2.description: OAuth2 bearer tokens issued by the Reserva authorization server. Signed-in Reserva users use the authorization code flow. Server-side integrations use the client credentials flow. Partner applications acting for their own end users obtain a token through OAuth2 token exchange (RFC 8693) on the same token endpoint.

info.description: Public REST API of Reserva for partners and integrations: search businesses, read their locations, services and resources, check availability and manage reservations. Tokens are issued by the Reserva authorization server (see the Reserva Auth API).
info.title: Reserva Resource API

get.description: Returns every business category with its name localized using the Accept-Language header.

get.description: Returns a page of the bookable resources (for example staff members or rooms) of a business.

get.description: Returns the reservations of the signed-in user.
